title: Bountiful Market Updated: August 2026 Position Report
summary: Bountiful platform updated with Almond Board of California August 2026 position report data.
body_markdown:
[Bountiful Market](https://app.bountiful.ag/market) has been updated with new data from the[August 2026 Almond Board of California position report.](https://www.almonds.org/sites/default/files/2026-09/2026.08_PosRpt_7535.pdf)


[Log in to Market](https://app.bountiful.ag/market?utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-8PRRz3tq1KjMn_JRldh4XFE0mAwGkAQlsf5S2aTEmLtJPnTZ1PfEzShRImde2FkCrmKE5f)


on the[Bountiful platform](http://app.bountiful.ag/) for your:


- Monthly Shipments
- Carry-out trends
- Crop Receipts by Variety
- Total Marketable Supply, Shipments vs Commitments


---


###
📈 Almond Crop Receipts up up 2025


August's position report marks the first month of the 2026/2027 marketing year.


Crop receipts to date: 401,853,217 lbs,


up +55.14%


over last year.


### ⚖️ Carry-Out -> Carry-In


**The resulting** **2026 Carry-In is 470,655,138 lbs** ,


**** down -


4.76%


from the Carry-Out per the July 2026 position report.


- 15.18% Carry-Out as a % of Total Marketable Supply (TMS)
- 17.90% Carry-Out as a % of Total Shipments


**Note: ABC finalized Loss & Exempt for 2025/26; actual L&E of 2.87% versus the 2% forecasted L&E figure, resulting in a negative adjustment of 23,531,399 lbs on Carry-Out.*


**


### 📊 TMS, Shipments & Commitments


August New Crop and Carry-In from 2025 bring the 2026


**beginning Total Marketable Supply to 864,471,291 lbs** , up +17.19%


over last year.


-


26/27 % TMS shipped to date:


21.99%


,


up + 0.60%


over last year


-


26/27


% Sold to date


: 79.53%


,


down -13.26%


over last year


### 🚢 2026 Shipments


**August's total shipments: 190,095,929** **lbs,** up +20.46%


over August


last year.

### 📈 Crop Receipt Projections


Following the December position report, we run a forward projection on ABC Form 1 crop receipts every month to get an idea of the total size of the crop.


The methodology we use for our crop receipt projections differs from our


[in-season machine learning forecasts](https://medium.com/@BountifulAg/forget-everything-you-know-about-forecasting-81b28ca05d2d?utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-8PRRz3tq1KjMn_JRldh4XFE0mAwGkAQlsf5S2aTEmLtJPnTZ1PfEzShRImde2FkCrmKE5f) . Our 2026 in-season forecasts are complete and have not been updated since we released a final forecast in August.
